Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning assault of a corrections officer, law enforcement officer, community corrections officer, or an employee responsible for the supervision of a sentenced offender in a detention facility.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assault of a corrections officer, lawenforcement officer, community corrections officer, or an employeeresponsible for the supervision of a sentenced offender in a detentionfacility; amending RCW 9A.36.011; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.36.011 and 1997 c 196 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of assault in the first degree if he orshe((,)): (a) With intent to inflict great bodily harm: (((a))) (i) Assaults another with a firearm or any deadly weapon orby any force or means likely to produce great bodily harm or death; or (((b))) (ii) Administers, exposes, or transmits to or causes to betaken by another, poison, the human immunodeficiency virus as definedin chapter 70.24 RCW, or any other destructive or noxious substance; or (((c))) (iii) Assaults another and inflicts great bodily harm; or (b) Assaults, with a deadly weapon, a corrections officer, lawenforcement officer, community corrections officer, or an employeeresponsible for the supervision of a sentenced offender in a detention p. 1 SSB 5058facility who was performing his or her official duties at the time ofthe assault, and the person knew or had reason to know that the victimwas a corrections officer, law enforcement officer, communitycorrections officer, or an employee responsible for the supervision ofa sentenced offender in a detention facility. (2) Assault in the first degree is a class A felony.
